description: Make a rigged, animated 3D character from a picture (.png, .jpg or .webp of one character, whole; up to 20 MB): a 3D model made from the picture, rigged with every animation for its body type, written as a .glb. Takes about 2 to 3 minutes (up to 5 when the GPU is starting) and costs $0.25 of API credits, refunded if it fails. Returns where the file was written, what was charged and the credits left.

animations.description: all (default), none (just the rig), or animation names from list_body_types

keep_arms_out.description: humans: keep the arms out of the body in every animation, on this computer after the download, as afk.ai/rig does (seconds to a minute)

output.description: where to write the rigged .glb (default: <picture>.rigged.glb next to it)

path.description: the picture (absolute, or relative to the server's working directory)

type.description: what the character is: human for anything on two legs, fox for dogs/cats/wolves, horse for hoofed animals, and so on

name: image_to_character
